assessment.claim: The recorded adapter is identified as Intel HD Graphics from the Sandy Bridge generation. Intel's Windows graphics-driver list includes the Pentium G630 among processors using Intel HD Graphics. Dortania's Sandy Bridge graphics guidance lists High Sierra 10.13.6 as the highest supported OS for the family, but its named iGPU list contains HD 2000, HD 3000, and HD P3000 rather than this exact PCI device ID. No exact-device Ventura result has been established.
limitations: Intel's driver list documents Windows driver support only; it does not establish macOS support.
The exact PCI ID PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_0102&SUBSYS_307C17AA&REV_09 is not individually named in the cited macOS graphics guide.
Do not relabel device ID 0102 as HD 2000 or HD 3000 without an exact mapping source.
The family-level graphics guidance is not an exact-device Ventura test and does not establish whole-system compatibility.

sources.title: Intel - List of Drivers for Intel Graphics
